what: The ten bubbles rendered under the published Fig. 4, one per bin, in bin order.
rule: Per bin of selected_rows.csv (the original 100-bubble set, binned on 1 - Phi_VA): among VOF bubbles, the one whose non_sphericity is nearest the bin median; an exact tie (two middle bubbles of an even-count bin) goes to the lower row_10k. This is the rule of plot_per_bin_mape_bars.py, which did not record its choice. plot_fig04_wadell_panel.py re-derives the ids with it and stops if they differ from the list below.
how_verified: Independently of the rule, each id was identified by matching its render's silhouette in the published PNG against the shipped 100x100 renders of all 10,000 benchmark bubbles; the rule reproduces all ten. Seven bins contain an exact median tie, and ordering the ties by row_10k is the only ordering tried (file, row_10k, name or nonsphericity, each ascending and descending) that reproduces every one.
note: All ten are among the 100 bubbles every retrained model held out of training. Four differ from selected_rows.csv's is_bin_thumbnail flags, which record a different choice.
